units.source_text: 对她们，我不好奇，也不轻视，完全忘掉她们是巡回演出艺人了。

en.t: Toward them, I felt neither curiosity nor contempt, and had completely forgotten that they were traveling performers.

units.source_text: 我这种不寻常的好意，似乎深深地渗进了她们的心。

en.t: This unusual kindness of mine seemed to sink deeply into their hearts.

units.source_text: 不觉间，我已决定到大岛她们的家去。

en.t: Before I knew it, I had already decided to go to their home on Oshima.
